info.title: RMM API
info.description: HTTP API routes and OpenAPI document

post.summary: Upload a release artifact; the server names it by its SHA-256.

get.summary:
Export the technician list draft for offline signing with
`rmm-sign sign --type techlist`. `seq` is the stored techlist's plus one,
`issued_at` is now and `expires_at` 30 days later; review them before
signing. A technician's `client_scope` lists the clients assigned in
`msp.technician_client` (empty means none).

200.description: TechnicianList JSON draft (byte fields as lowercase hex)

post.summary: Invoke a catalog definition on an agent.

503.description: Command key missing or command not published

post.summary: Revoke an agent and tell NATS to drop its connection.

204.description: Agent revoked and connection kick published

503.description: Agent revoked but the kick was not published; retry

post.summary: Ask for a shell grant on an agent.

201.description: Grant stored; sign the challenge with the hardware key

403.description: No registered credential, or the agent is outside the technician's clients

post.summary: Approve a device held for review (`pending_review` or `flagged`).

204.description: Device and its agent activated; the original device's agents superseded

404.description: Unknown device or not held for review

503.description: Approved but the kick of superseded agents was not published; retry

post.summary: Reject a device held for review: its agents are revoked.

204.description: Agents of the device revoked and kick published

404.description: Unknown device or not held for review

503.description: Rejected but the kick was not published; retry

post.summary: Open a granted shell with the hardware key's assertion.

parameters.name: grant_id
parameters.description: Grant id (unpadded base64url) or session id (hex)

410.description: Grant expired before it was opened

503.description: Command key, manifest or command stream unavailable

500.description: The file does not match the stored hash

get.summary: Connect the browser to a shell session opened with a ticket.

101.description: WebSocket upgrade: binary frames carry terminal bytes, text frames carry JSON control

401.description: Ticket unknown, used, expired or for another session

409.description: Session is not waiting for a browser

post.summary: Start registering a hardware credential for the calling technician.

503.description: Attestation or trust manifest not configured

post.summary: Finish registration: verify the hardware attestation and store the credential.

503.description: Attestation or trust manifest not configured

put.summary: Upload a signed trust artifact (a release manifest is `release`).

get.summary: Download an artifact by its SHA-256 (no authentication: the hash is signed).

finished_at.description: Completion time (RFC 3339), once the agent reported.

stages.description: Per-stage outcomes reported by the agent.

content_id.description: Hex SHA-256 of the definition payload.

new.description: False when the same definition was already stored.

CreateTokenRequest.description: Request to mint an enrollment token.

allow_reattach.description: Whether a device may be reattached by this token.

CreateTokenResponse.description: A freshly minted token; the secret is shown only here.

credential_id_b64url.description:
Credential that will co-sign. Required when the technician has more
than one non-revoked credential.

max_duration_secs.description: Longest session length in seconds (default 3600, at most 14400).

GrantResponse.description: A grant waiting for its WebAuthn assertion.

allow_credentials.description: Credential ids allowed to sign, unpadded base64url.

challenge_b64url.description: WebAuthn challenge to sign, unpadded base64url.

open_by.description: Latest time the grant may be opened (unix seconds).

Health.description: Body returned by the health endpoint.

status.description: Always `ok` when the process is serving.

IssueRequest.description: Request to invoke a catalog definition on one agent.

definition_content_id.description: Hex content id of an uploaded definition.

credential_id_b64url.description: `rawId` of the credential that signed, unpadded base64url.

OpenResponse.description: A session that was handed to the agent.

session_id.description: Session id (the grant id as lowercase hex).

ws_url.description: Relay path including the ticket; connect with `wss://<api host><ws_url>`.

exclude_credentials_b64url.description: Credentials already registered by this technician, unpadded base64url.

sha256_hex.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 computed by the server; the artifact's name.
